 Save the date November 28th for Malvern’s Annual ‘Christmas on King Festival’ 
 Santa’s arrival, the Burke Park Tree-Lighting and MOMS Club Fundraising will highlight day
 Share this:
 Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) 
 Facebook 
 Share on X (Opens in new window) 
 X 
 During “Christmas on King,” MOMS Club of Malvern members offer goodies to two young customers. (Photo submitted by Mary Brown)
 By Mary Brown | mbrown@sju.edu PUBLISHED: November 17, 2026 at 11:07 AM EST Getting your Trinity Audio player ready... Preparations are well under-way for the November 28th iteration of the greatly successful festival known as “Christmas On King” from noon to 4 p.m. in the Borough of Malvern.
 Lead organizers are the Malvern Business and Professional Association and Synergy Gymnastics.
 Music and aromas will fill the air for the many visitors who will walk up and down King Street and then stroll into Burke Park from 4 p.m. to 6 p.m. to take in the frolicking fun – something for everyone.
 Top of the list will be the antique red fire engine truck the perch of which will accommodate a very jolly Santa Claus, for the upcoming 2026 Thanksgiving weekend.
 12 p.m. to 4 p.m. on KING STREET:
 LIVE MUSIC: Carolers along King Street and Sin Brothers band at the Beer Garden
 FOOD TRUCKS: The Polish Connection, Good Girls on the Go! (Gourmet Grilled Cheese and Soup), Oola Bowls, Mayday Coffee Cruiser, Donut NV
 BEER GARDEN: Locust Lane Craft Brewery & Dressler Estate
 ACTIVITIES: Santa, Mrs. Claus, Elves, and the Grinch on King, Face painters, Balloon artists, Live Ice Sculpture carving, Typewriter Poet, Video Game Truck, Local Merchant Pop-ups, and more!
 See the event map on the website for details.
 4 p.m. to 6 p.m. in BURKE PARK:
 FOOD and DRINK: Mayday Coffee Truck, Donut NV, Locust Lane Craft Brewery, Dressler Estate, Rockin’ Cotton Candy
 PERFORMANCES: Malvern Prep Men’s Chorus and the Villa Maria Vocalise, Ballet 180 nutcracker performance, Uptown Singers, Twirl Performing Arts dancers, One Voice Chorus
 ACTIVITIES: Gingerbread cookie decorating, visit with Santa, hot cocoa
 TREE LIGHTING: arrive by 4:50 pm!
 Monies will be raised for numerous good causes and the effort by members of the Moms Club of Malvern will, as usual, tug at the heartstrings.
 “Now in its 31st year, MOMS Club® stands for Moms Offering Moms Support, and that’s exactly what happens! The MOMS Club of Malvern, Pennsylvania is an easy way to meet other moms in the area, connect during local events and find new playmates for your children.
 “You do not need to be a full-time stay-at-home mom to join our club — many of our members work full-time, part-time or have a home-based business.
 “Mothers of any age children are welcome! We know you still need support as your children grow and we are inclusive of all mothers — regardless of race, religion, or socio-economic status.
 “The MOMS Club of Malvern, Pennsylvania includes residents of Great Valley School District.
 “We are part of an international, non-profit organization. There are 2,000-plus chapters in the US with over 100,000 members and international chapters have already started forming as well.”
 In years past, MOMS Club members have supported Prepared to Thrive, People’s Pantry, Home of The Sparrow, Chester County Food Bank, Chester County SPCA, and Malvern Fire Company.
 At the Burke Park events in Malvern, Santa Claus chats with a family about gift requests for Christmas. (Photo submitted by Mary Brown) 
 For 2026, MOMS CLUB has donated over $3,000 to Great Valley Community Organization.
 A large portion of the proceeds went to a program which the community center runs called Team Up Gym.
 Team Up Gym is a free gym program for children with disabilities. The donation to this effort allows the program to buy adaptive equipment.
 MOMS Club of Malvern comprises 115-plus moms living in Malvern, Pennsylvania. Monthly events allow flexibility to join based on members’ unique schedules.
 Members plan a variety of play dates, music classes, story times, moms’ nights out, book club, seasonal events, and more.
 MOMS Club is a great way to get to know other moms and children in the area, and be a part of a group of moms who strive to give back to their community.
 Most of MOMS Club activities, playgroups, and service projects occur close to Malvern and Great Valley, also with outings to museums, zoos and other kid-friendly places in the vicinity.
 Events, both large and small, are hosted throughout the year. Active members are required to host 2 events per year, including meeting at a park, going for a walk, or grabbing a bite to eat together.
 The MOMS Club of Malvern is a local chapter of the International MOMS Club (MOMS Offering Moms Support), non-profit and non-denominational, offering the following events: Playgroups, Weekly Walks, Holiday Parties, Music Classes, Library Events, and Playground Meet-ups.
